subject: Confirming MAP security gating & retention window for EdgeBank POC
messages:
From: Maya Singh <security@edgebank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tomas Rivera <tomas.rivera@edgebank.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: SIG/CAIQ + retention window questions for POC

Jordan — thanks for the demo last week. Security team reviewed the MAP and we have a few preservation/retention questions before we sign off on the 'acceptance' gate: 

- Can Redwood provide an explicit maximum retention window for inference logs and embeddings tied to the POC instance? EdgeBank policy requires a technical retention ceiling (not policy language) to be able to scope our data lifecycle.
- SIG/CAIQ: we noted a handful of unanswered items in section 7.2 about key management and tenant isolation. Can you point to an owner and approximate delivery date for those artifacts?
- SOC 2: we need the SOC 2 summary and a list of any carve-outs that might impact how we treat production-like PII during the POC.

I'll attach the spreadsheet with the questions for reference. We're aiming to hit 'MAP acceptance' the week of Aug 23; if these items require additional time that affects our close timeline.

Thanks — Maya
Security Lead, EdgeBank
Attachments: EdgeBank_SIG_CAIX_Questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <security@edgebank.com>
Cc: Tomas Rivera <tomas.rivera@edgebank.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: SIG/CAIQ + retention window questions for POC

Maya — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front and a proposed short plan: 

- Retention: for the POC we can commit to a maximum of 30 days for raw inference logs and 90 days for embeddings by configuration. If EdgeBank needs a shorter operational window we can adjust per-route; the MAP will capture the exact per-route setting.

- SIG/CAIQ artifacts: Laura (Legal) will own the SIG responses we can provide a redlined CAIQ export for the POC by Aug 18. Marcus (Infra) will provide details on tenant isolation and KMS integration.

- SOC 2 summary: I'll attach the one-page SOC 2 summary and list of carve-outs.

Proposed timeline: Redlined SIG/CAIQ & SOC2 summary — Aug 18; Final MAP with retention settings & evidence plan — Aug 20; Acceptance gate review — week of Aug 23 (we can do a 30-minute review).

If that sounds OK I'll kick off Mary/Legal/Infra tasks and share the MAP_v1_EdgeBank_review.docx for your comments.

— Jordan
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf; MAP_v1_EdgeBank_review.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <security@edgebank.com>, Tomas Rivera <tomas.rivera@edgebank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: SIG/CAIQ + retention window questions for POC

Hi all — looping in Legal to confirm DPA redline path and scope for the POC. Key notes: 

- DPA carve-outs: we'll propose a POC-scoped exhibit that limits the data types processed to "non-production customer data" for the pilot, but provides the customer control to require shorter retention via per-route settings.
- KMS & key custody: Redwood supports AWS KMS and customer-managed keys in Dedicated/Private. For the hosted POC we will provide documentation showing key usage patterns and encryption-at-rest details.
- Evidence delivery: we can share SOC 2 summary (no full report) and SIG/CAIQ exports for the POC. If EdgeBank needs the full SOC 2 report we can discuss an execution plan (NDA/ACR).

I'll prepare suggested language for the MAP that explicitly states the 30/90-day ceilings and an owner for each deliverable. Suggest we add a single acceptance criterion line under 'Security Gate' that references the SIG/CAIQ artifacts and a SOC 2 summary receipt.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
Attachments: DPA_POC_Exhibit_template.docx (will circulate by EOD Aug 14)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <security@edgebank.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: SIG/CAIQ + retention window questions for POC

Adding technical constraints and implementation notes: 

- Retention mechanics: embeddings are stored in a configurable blobstore with TTL; we can set envelope TTL at route-level. Raw inference logs (request/response) are held in rolling segments and trimmed; 30 days is straightforward for the POC.
- Pseudonymization: we can apply a pre-processing hook to strip/replace specific PII token patterns before logs are materialized — will require a small transform rule set (I can provide examples).
- Evidence: I'll produce an infra diagram that shows tenant boundaries, KV access controls, and the KMS flow (will include key IDs redacted) by Aug 18.

One operational ask: if EdgeBank needs <30-day retention for any route, we need an explicit per-route config in the MAP and a timetable for enforcement. Otherwise we'll apply the default POC ceilings.

— Marcus
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Infra_Tenant_Isolation_v1.pdf (diagram, redacted)

From: Maya Singh <security@edgebank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tomas Rivera <tomas.rivera@edgebank.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: SIG/CAIQ + retention window questions for POC

Thanks — that helps. Two quick clarifying items: 

1) For embeddings: can you confirm whether embeddings derived from PII will be removed or re-generated if we require a shorter retention window? In other words, will the model's cache/kv store be invalidated or will there be orphaned derivatives?
2) For the SOC 2 summary: can Redwood confirm there are no carve-outs that would affect encryption-at-rest or KMS usage for tenant keys? We need the explicit statement for our audit screener.

If you can answer those by EOD Aug 18 we'll try to keep the MAP acceptance on track for Aug 23.

— Maya

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <security@edgebank.com>, Tomas Rivera <tomas.rivera@edgebank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: SIG/CAIQ + retention window questions for POC

Maya/Tomas — quick answers and next steps (closing the MAP items):

1) Embeddings lifecycle: if EdgeBank requests a shorter retention (<90 days) we will trigger a per-route reindex/TTL purge that will remove stored embeddings. For model-side caches: runtime KV caches are ephemeral and not part of the persisted embedding store; they will be invalidated on config changes. Marcus will include the purge sequence in the infra doc.

2) SOC 2 carve-outs: Redwood's SOC 2 Type II summary indicates no carve-outs impacting encryption-at-rest or KMS handling for customer keys in Dedicated/Private. For hosted POC we surface the encryption patterns in the SOC2 summary; Laura will add a one-line confirmation in the DPA exhibit.

Next steps I will: 
- Share the redlined SIG/CAIQ export and DPA_POC_Exhibit (Aug 18 EOD).
- Publish MAP_v1_EdgeBank_review.docx with per-route retention defaults and acceptance criteria (Aug 19).
- Schedule 30-min acceptance review for Aug 24 at 11:00 PT.

If that timeline looks good please confirm; we'll block the meeting.

— Jordan
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_v1_EdgeBank_review.docx (updated), Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (attached earlier)
